query:
SELECT
                        (
                            SELECT COUNT(*)
                            FROM dataset_key_blocks
                            WHERE dataset_id = $1 AND block_ref_name = $2
                                AND ($3 IS NULL OR event_type IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($3)))
                        ) + (
                            SELECT COUNT(*)
                            FROM dataset_data_blocks
                            WHERE dataset_id = $1 AND block_ref_name = $2
                                AND ($3 IS NULL OR event_type IN (SELECT value FROM json_each($3)))
                        ) AS "count!: i64"
